name: Jacaelon Targaryen
subtitle: Hand of the King

abilities.name: Silent Verdict
abilities.description: When judging a rival, weakens their standing at court without drawing blood.

abilities.name: Every Warning True
abilities.description: Gains influence whenever a prior prediction is proven correct.

flavorQuote: If this man actually manages to kill Gaelor, he will have done the Crown a favor.

name: Baelenys Targaryen
subtitle: King of the Seven Kingdoms

abilities.name: Iron Wrath
abilities.description: Crushes dissent instantly; nearby rivals lose standing when he enters the room.

abilities.name: Formidable
abilities.description: Survives what should have killed him — permanently scarred but unbroken.

flavorQuote: So many years...

name: Gaelor Targaryen
subtitle: The Housebreaker

abilities.name: Blackfyre's Weight
abilities.description: Wielding the ancestral blade, deals devastating blows in single combat.

abilities.name: Housebreaker
abilities.description: Massacres resistance entirely — at the cost of lasting infamy.

flavorQuote: My head is still intact.

name: Visenor Targaryen
subtitle: Crown Prince in Exile

abilities.name: Bond of Patience
abilities.description: Tames the untamed — earned the trust of a wild, ancient dragon through patience alone.

abilities.name: Hidden Claim
abilities.description: Gains hidden allies while believed dead or lost.

flavorQuote: I am supposed to want my throne, but for the first time in my life, I am at peace.

name: Jaery Targaryen
subtitle: Queen of the Seven Kingdoms

abilities.name: The People Have Suffered Enough
abilities.description: Once per round, cancels a punishment or decree before it reaches the realm.

abilities.name: A Mother's Plea
abilities.description: Compels two warring allies to stand down — at least until the next morning.

flavorQuote: I do not want to be with my husband anymore. You are not the man I knew.

name: Baelor Targaryen
subtitle: Grand Maester

abilities.name: The Argumentative One
abilities.description: Whenever a rash decree is issued, may force a recount of votes at the council table.

abilities.name: Economic Pressure
abilities.description: Forces a rival city or house to expel a named target without open war.

flavorQuote: Gaelor ruined my life. I had to abandon Oldtown. My entire reputation there was destroyed because of him.

name: Saera Targaryen
subtitle: Cloud Eyes

abilities.name: Cloud Eyes
abilities.description: Sees through deception; cannot be misled by false reports or forged evidence.

abilities.name: Cloudgazer's Shadow
abilities.description: When she commits her dragon, rivals cannot retreat or hide.

flavorQuote: My king, will you punish years of loyal service for the deeds of one stranger?

name: Ser Alester Dayne
subtitle: Kingsguard

abilities.name: Dawn's Edge
abilities.description: In single combat, ignores the first wound dealt against him each round.

abilities.name: Rise, Ser Jacaelon
abilities.description: May confer a knighthood. The knighted ally gains +2 power until end of game.

flavorQuote: The only reason I am alive is King Baelenys.

name: Rhaella Targaryen
subtitle: Princess in Hiding

abilities.name: Dangerous Name
abilities.description: Merely being found with her costs an ally significant standing at court.

abilities.name: I Just Need to Sleep
abilities.description: Removes one pursuit token from her location each round she remains hidden.

flavorQuote: I just need to sleep.

name: Maela Targaryen
subtitle: The Twin

abilities.name: Jadefyre's Rider
abilities.description: Controls an inherited dragon; gains power proportional to how long she has held it.

abilities.name: Buried Secret
abilities.description: A hidden threat. If revealed, deals influence damage to the ally who exposed her.

flavorQuote: You gave him a lesson he will not soon forget. Whether the realm realizes it or not, you won.

abilities.name: Dark Sister's Legacy
abilities.description: Commands agents inside enemy territory; their actions cannot be traced back to him.

abilities.name: Unknown Dragon
abilities.description: Deploys a dragon of unverified strength — power value hidden until combat begins.

name: Derrin Hightower
subtitle: Former Hand of the King

abilities.name: Love Alone Cannot Preserve a Dynasty
abilities.description: May redirect punishment for a failed conspiracy onto a house ally, sparing himself.

abilities.name: The Confession
abilities.description: When captured, reveals all allied conspirators — but grants one final act before death.

flavorQuote: Love alone cannot preserve a dynasty.

name: Visenya Targaryen
subtitle: The Blindfolded Blade

abilities.name: Not Blind
abilities.description: Ignores concealment — sees through disguises and hidden positions.

abilities.name: Dark Sister at Your Throat
abilities.description: May neutralize a target without killing them, leaving a message instead.

flavorQuote: We finally meet, cousin.

name: Lorenah Dayne
subtitle: Lady of Torrentine

abilities.name: Starfall's Shadow
abilities.description: An ally hidden under her protection cannot be found by pursuit unless she is defeated first.

abilities.name: We Breathe the Same Air
abilities.description: Reduces hostility between two opposing factions by one tier.

flavorQuote: We breathe the same air. We stand beneath the same stars. Why must we always find reasons to hate one another?

name: Renrose Tyrell
subtitle: Lord of Highgarden

abilities.name: The Mander's Pact
abilities.description: Binds an ally's claim to his own; both gain power equal to the other's influence score.

abilities.name: Eyes in Every Room
abilities.description: Whenever an ally enters a new location, Renrose receives a copy of their intelligence.

flavorQuote: My father loved these gardens dearly. Before your father had him executed, of course.

name: Naella Velaryon
subtitle: Princess of Driftmark

abilities.name: For Tonight, Only My Husband
abilities.description: Removes one stress or rage token from Gaelor; he cannot act recklessly this round.

abilities.name: Your Seed Is Strong
abilities.description: When her child is confirmed, Gaelor gains +1 power permanently.

flavorQuote: If you weren't nervous, I'd think you didn't understand what today means.

name: Berholt Caswell
subtitle: High Septon

abilities.name: The Gods Will Judge
abilities.description: May override a death sentence with a sentence of the Wall — once per game.

abilities.name: Quiet Conscience
abilities.description: Costs no influence to align with, but grants no influence in return.

flavorQuote: You know an innocent girl was butchered. Do you want to cross the gods?

name: Vhaemys Targaryen
subtitle: The King's Little Shadow

abilities.name: Let's All Go for a Walk
abilities.description: Once per game, her presence defuses an escalating confrontation before blood is drawn.

abilities.name: Trust Is More Important Than Love
abilities.description: The ally she declares loyalty to gains +1 influence for the rest of the game.

flavorQuote: Anyway, trust is more important than love.

name: Ser Saathos Maris
subtitle: Gaelor's Sworn Sword

abilities.name: Hold the Door
abilities.description: Denies entry to a location; even a royal command requires overcoming him first.

abilities.name: The Blonde Knight
abilities.description: May spend an action to investigate a death; gains one hidden clue token.

flavorQuote: Need me to hold it for you, my Prince?

name: Steffon Baratheon
subtitle: The Young Stag

abilities.name: A Baratheon Kneels When He Feels Safe
abilities.description: Cannot be compelled to show deference; ignores intimidation effects.

abilities.name: The Hollow Crown
abilities.description: Won the tourney by default; gains the champion title but not the glory.

flavorQuote: A Baratheon kneels when he feels safe.

name: Ser Brant Costayne
subtitle: The Reckoning

abilities.name: Knights of Oldtown
abilities.description: When he falls, all Reach-aligned characters gain +1 power for the remainder of the game.

abilities.name: Trial by Combat
abilities.description: May demand single combat in lieu of any verdict; forces the plaintiff to fight personally.

flavorQuote: I stopped trusting the justice of the Seven Kingdoms a long time ago.

abilities.name: The Last Name Standing
abilities.description: While she lives, House Hightower cannot be fully eliminated from the game.

abilities.name: Uneasy Sanctuary
abilities.description: May shelter a fugitive, but doing so costs her 2 influence each round they remain.

name: Weylar Rocke
subtitle: Master of Whisperers

abilities.name: Little Birds
abilities.description: Once per round, reveals one hidden piece of information about any character on the board.

abilities.name: Pardon Bought in Terror
abilities.description: Cannot betray Jacaelon while Jacaelon lives; loyalty is absolute and involuntary.

flavorQuote: My little birds have brought me a song, my Prince.

name: Godfrey Blackwood
subtitle: Lord of Raventree Hall

abilities.name: Gracious in Defeat
abilities.description: When eliminated from combat, deals 1 influence damage to his opponent regardless.

abilities.name: Tackled into the Mud
abilities.description: Once per game, prevents an assassination attempt mid-action.

flavorQuote: What a jolly day for the peasants.

name: Rickard Stark
subtitle: Lord of Winterfell

abilities.name: The North Remembers
abilities.description: Cannot be intimidated by Targaryen influence; Northern loyalty runs deeper than dragons.

abilities.name: When People Look Up
abilities.description: Grants +1 influence to a Targaryen ally if he openly supports them.

flavorQuote: When people look up, they want to see someone like you.

abilities.name: He Asked for Parley
abilities.description: If killed without a fair trial, all Reach-aligned characters gain +2 power permanently.

abilities.name: Desperate Steel
abilities.description: In his final action, may strike back against any foe regardless of power difference.

abilities.name: Curtass Was Nothing Special
abilities.description: Deals +2 power against any character who previously defeated or disgraced a Kingsguard.

abilities.name: Seven Feet of Grievance
abilities.description: Once per game, forces any character who underestimates him to re-engage in combat at a disadvantage.

abilities.name: I Was Never Raised to Be a Lady
abilities.description: Opponents who underestimate her based on gender or birth lose 1 power before combat begins.

abilities.name: Blade at Your Throat
abilities.description: Once per game, pins a target and ends their action for the round without killing them.

name: Cordin Poole
subtitle: Maester

abilities.name: And Who Else's Would It Be?
abilities.description: Flatters the most powerful character in play; gains 1 influence from them each round.

abilities.name: Sons Must Pay
abilities.description: Once per game, silences one ongoing argument or challenge at the council table — the affected player loses their next action.

flavorQuote: Sons must pay the price for their fathers' ambitions.

name: Ser Orwell Morrigen
subtitle: Lord Commander of the Kingsguard

abilities.name: Experience Triumphs
abilities.description: In combat against a younger character, gains +2 power.

abilities.name: Running Out of Patience
abilities.description: Once per game, demands an accounting from any ally who has acted without orders.

flavorQuote: Experience triumphs over youth and speed. The men you truly must fear are the experienced ones.

name: Curtass Whent
subtitle: Former Kingsguard

abilities.name: Fixers Don't Make Songs
abilities.description: Cannot be assigned honorable death; dies off-screen when defeated.

abilities.name: They Pass Over Real Men
abilities.description: Deals +2 power against Kingsguard characters specifically.

flavorQuote: You know what the problem with the Kingsguard is? They pass over fixers — real men like me.

name: Ser Brannyn Vance
subtitle: Sworn Shield, Broken

abilities.name: I Cannot Draw Steel Against Royal Blood
abilities.description: Cannot attack any Targaryen character. Takes full damage from them without retaliation.

abilities.name: When He Falls, Everything Falls
abilities.description: When eliminated, deals 2 influence damage to every character currently holding a secret token. If any of those characters are Targaryen, they take 3 instead.

flavorQuote: Of course I felt it. How could I not?

name: Malaenar Targaryen
subtitle: Lord of Dragonstone

abilities.name: Renounced and Reliable
abilities.description: Cannot be drawn into succession conflict; immune to kingmaking pressure.

abilities.name: Dragonstone's Quiet
abilities.description: Holds a strategic location without requiring upkeep.

flavorQuote: Even though I never showed it, I always envied you. Especially for how you stood up to our father.

name: Tansy Riverside
subtitle: Paramour of Dragonstone

abilities.name: She Organized the Whole Thing
abilities.description: Once per game, triggers a social event without her ally's knowledge — all consequences fall on her instead of him.

abilities.name: She Held His Gaze
abilities.description: Cannot be dismissed or removed from play by intimidation alone; requires an active political action.

flavorQuote: I am so deeply honored that you graced us with your presence today.

abilities.name: Whereabouts Unknown
abilities.description: Cannot be targeted by any player while her location remains hidden.

abilities.name: Death in His Own Bed
abilities.description: When played, immediately triggers one diplomatic event between Stark and Targaryen.

abilities.name: Deal With the Money
abilities.description: Reduces the cost of any decree or campaign by 1 resource — if anyone listens.

abilities.name: A War With No Clear End
abilities.description: May delay a military campaign by one round by presenting financial projections.

name: Martyn Mullendore
subtitle: Knight of the Reach

abilities.name: I Have a Good Memory for Faces
abilities.description: Cannot be fooled by disguise; automatically identifies hidden characters.

abilities.name: Loyalty to the Prince
abilities.description: His allegiance runs to Visenor personally, not to the house that employs him.

flavorQuote: You are in the absolute last place in the realm you should be, my Prince.

abilities.name: My Father Can Send—
abilities.description: Attempts to summon Tyrell reinforcements; can be quietly shut down by any senior ally.

abilities.name: Proud of His Name
abilities.description: Gains +1 influence whenever a Tyrell character is mentioned in play.

name: Almar Larchmont
subtitle: Maester of the Hightower

abilities.name: He Is Maester Arthur
abilities.description: Maintains a cover identity for one ally; costs 1 influence per round to sustain.

abilities.name: Do Not Forget It, My Lady
abilities.description: Once per game, corrects a dangerous slip before it reaches hostile ears.

flavorQuote: From this day forth, we shall not refer to our guest as a prince. He is Maester Arthur. Do not forget it, my lady.

abilities.name: They Are Utterly Fucked
abilities.description: Delivers the most accurate intelligence report in play, without diplomatic softening.

abilities.name: Confirmed the Pregnancy
abilities.description: When played alongside Rhaella, triggers a permanent narrative event.

name: Alysanne Hightower
subtitle: A Quiet Tragedy
keywords: The One They Did Not Mean to Kill

abilities.name: Unintended
abilities.description: When eliminated, the character who caused it loses 3 influence permanently.

abilities.name: Watching from the Window
abilities.description: When in play, all incoming threats are visible one round before they arrive.

abilities.name: An Unfortunate Accident
abilities.description: When accused of an act, may claim plausible deniability — reduces evidence weight by 1 unless a witness token is present.

abilities.name: Tully Blood Now
abilities.description: While allied with a Tully character, ignores one Crown challenge per round.

abilities.name: A Drunken Mistake
abilities.description: Once per game, dismisses a border dispute without consequence — but loses 1 influence from both sides permanently.

abilities.name: Tied to the Brackens
abilities.description: Cannot oppose Bracken-allied characters while his house is bound by the current marriage pact.

name: Blackfyre
subtitle: Ancestral Valyrian Steel Sword

abilities.name: Mark of the Heir
abilities.description: Whoever wields it is seen by the realm as the King's chosen successor.

flavorQuote: Steel changed hands. So too did favor.

name: Dark Sister
subtitle: Ancestral Valyrian Steel Sword

abilities.name: At Your Throat
abilities.description: When wielded, may neutralize a target without killing — leaving them alive and shaken.

flavorQuote: The rumors were true. You are still rock hard.

abilities.name: Sword of the Morning
abilities.description: Shatters lesser steel on contact; any non-Valyrian blade that strikes it is destroyed.
